connector.name: Miromiro
connector.registryDescription: Turn any live website into brand colors, fonts, design tokens, SVGs, Lottie and paste-ready code.
connector.summary: Hosted at miromiro.app over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package miromiro-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace app.miromiro. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MIROMIRO_API_KEY
env.description: API key from https://miromiro.app/api/dashboard (free tier: 100 credits/month, no card)
